xs.$description: 12px in website context (16px base). For captions, labels, badges, counters inside buttons.

sm.$description: 14px in website context (16px base). Secondary body text, helper text, small UI elements.

base.$description: 16px in website context (16px base). Default body text size, website baseline.

md.$description: 18px in website context (16px base). Slightly larger body text, emphasized content.

lg.$description: 20px in website context (16px base). Large body text, subheadings.

xl.$description: 24px in website context (16px base). Heading level 6, card titles.

2xl.$description: 30px in website context (16px base). Heading level 5.

3xl.$description: 36px in website context (16px base). Heading level 4.

4xl.$description: 48px in website context (16px base). Heading level 3.

5xl.$description: 60px in website context (16px base). Heading level 2.

6xl.$description: 72px in website context (16px base). Heading level 1, hero text.
